title: Tokyo Eye
valueStatement: Governed scientific-AI platform for drug discovery and structural inference using hyperbolic geometry.
architectureHighlight: Context-bound agents and MLflow gates keep models inside the current structure, evidence, and scientist control plane.
description: A governed scientific-AI discovery environment for structural inference and ligand–protein work: hyperbolic geometry, atom-level models, and a scientist control plane that keeps AI inside the current data, structure, and workflow — not a disconnected chatbot.
pitch: Governed scientific-AI platform for drug discovery and structural inference using hyperbolic geometry.
challenge: Scientific assistants fail when they sit next to the work instead of in it — inventing plausible chemistry, ignoring the open structure, and leaving no provenance. Tokyo Eye had to bind agents to the current graph, selected residues, and preregistered metric gates, and recover when the first GNN underperformed.
development: Architected a hyperbolic GNN path, then pivoted in one day to an atom-level Transformer / Mixture-of-Experts replacement that produced Pearson 0.407 on the same-day evaluation. Wrapped training in MLflow with immutable gates, ablations, and failed-run preservation. Scientist-facing flows use XState guardrails, Hypothesis tests, deterministic structural-biology checks, and RCSB semantic search. Two static HTML demos: Discovery Story (narrative walkthrough) and Discovery Cockpit (control plane).
outcome: A discovery environment where models, geometry, and literature sit on one control plane; unproven capability stays separated from completed evidence. Story demo is linked from this page; Cockpit is the scientist UI. Source lives in tokyo-eye-agenticpoincare and tokyo-eye---eidetix-bio.

journey.title: Put AI in the scientist’s actual context
journey.description: Rejected chatbot-beside-the-work. The agent must see current structures, selected residues, workflow stage, and visual state before it is allowed to speak.

journey.title: Hyperbolic geometry as the spatial prior
journey.description: Used Poincaré / hyperbolic embeddings so hierarchical molecular relationships stay continuous instead of flattening into a Euclidean bag of atoms.

journey.title: GNN miss, same-day Transformer pivot
journey.description: When the PyTorch GNN underperformed, replaced it with an atom-level Transformer / MoE, trained and evaluated in one day (Pearson 0.407).

journey.title: Evidence gates, not vibes
journey.description: MLflow with preregistered estimates, immutable metric gates, ablations, and preservation of failed experiments so a pretty number cannot quietly replace a registered one.

journey.title: Control plane and story
journey.description: Discovery Cockpit for live scientific control; Discovery Story as the narrative walkthrough of how a finding is supposed to feel when the system is honest.

specs.title: Context-bound scientific agents
specs.description: LLM workflows are constrained by XState, the open structure, and the current visual selection. The model cannot answer as if the protein were not on screen.

specs.title: Hyperbolic GNN → atom-level Transformer
specs.description: Geometry-first structural inference; when the GNN failed the gate, the architecture changed in a day instead of explaining the miss away.

specs.title: MLflow as governance, not a dashboard
specs.description: Preregistered metrics, immutable gates, ablations, provenance, and failed runs kept on purpose so champion/challenger is real.

specs.title: Deterministic biology checks
specs.description: Python Hypothesis tests plus structural-biology validators sit in front of generative output. Plausible text is not a result.

specs.title: RCSB in the loop
specs.description: Semantic search against RCSB so literature and deposited structures are retrieval, not recollection from the model’s training cutoff.
